prompt: pick up the tomato sauce and put it in the tray
observation_source: 5571 frames of the 50 LIBERO-90 t59 demos (/workspace/data/libero_datasets/libero_90/LIVING_ROOM_SCENE3_pick_up_the_tomato_sauce_and_put_it_in_the_tray_demo.hdf5), sim states re-rendered at 256 px and processed as the eval client does

base.sampler: pps_real.sampler.sample_actions, eager, Recorder hook, bit exact vs stock eager

recipe: paper Eq. 5 and Appendix A.3, on policy. (x_t, t, v_base) at each of the 10 Euler steps along the base's own sampling path from fresh Gaussian noise
time_convention: openpi, t = 1 is noise, t = 0 is data, Euler dt = -0.1, x_(k+1) = x_k + dt * v_k

features.source: final layer PaliGemma prefix hidden states (after final norm), computed once per frame by the base during sampling
features.rows: 0..15 agentview tokens average pooled 16x16 to 4x4 (row major), 16..31 wrist tokens pooled the same way, 32 mean over valid language tokens

action_dims: all 32 model dims are stored. LIBERO uses the first 7, the other 25 are padding the base still denoises, so they are part of x_t

split.note: a marker only, nothing was dropped

base_forward_passes.note: the prefix is recomputed for every row, so the 16 draws of a frame each pay one prefix pass
